literal: Having learned, here true reality those who saw, will attain again here not-coming path.
translation: Those who have learned and realized the true reality in this world will attain the path that does not lead back here again.
modern: கற்க வேண்டியவற்றைக் கற்று, இவ்வுலகில் உண்மையான பொருளைக் கண்டவர்கள், மீண்டும் இவ்வுலகிற்குப் பிறந்து வராத வழியை அடைவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet describes the ultimate reward for realizing the truth. The word 'ஈண்டு' can mean 'abundantly' or 'here', but 'here' best fits the context of worldly existence. By learning deeply and seeing the true reality (மெய்ப்பொருள்) while living here, a person achieves the highest goal. They will enter the path (நெறி) that ensures they do not return here again (மற்று ஈண்டு வாரா), signifying freedom from returning to this worldly life.
